gui.refinedstorage.crafting_grid.press_s: Press SHIFT + CMD to only show items used in the recipe.
gui.refinedstorage.priority.storage_help: Click to modify the insert/extract priority.
Press CTRL + click to modify the insert priority.
Press CMD + click to modify the insert priority.
Press ALT + click to modify the extract priority.

text.autoconfig.refinedstorage.option.re: Whether networks and items require energy to function. If false, networks do not need a Controller to function.
